title: RETI Light Modpack
description: A balanced medieval adventure modpack focused on world enhancement, exploration, and creativity. RETI Light blends medieval and light steampunk themes with optimized performance and immersive gameplay for the Repairimals community.
body:
**RETI Light** is a carefully balanced Minecraft modpack designed for immersive exploration, world enhancement, and creative adventure. Focused on a **medieval** to light **steampunk** aesthetic, it offers a deep and atmospheric experience. The pack includes a wide range of performance, building, and adventure mods — from overhauled mobs and realistic sounds to improved world generation and visual upgrades through shaders and optimization tools. Players can expect a smoother, more vibrant world filled with dungeons, ruins, and diverse biomes, encouraging both builders and adventurers alike. Whether you’re crafting intricate machinery with Create, exploring ancient structures with YUNG’s Better Series, or customizing your story with Custom NPCs, RETI Light provides a stable, visually rich, and lore-friendly experience. Built and tested by the **Repairimals**, this pack is ideal for those seeking performance, atmosphere, and creativity in perfect harmony. **Mod List:**
